// Fixed types for task (h). Do not edit; check.sh uses its own copy.
import type { ReadonlyStore } from "@get-modular/observation";

/** The quotes module's own slice of the settings. */
export type RateSettings = { readonly eurUsd: number };
export type QuotesDeps = { readonly settings: ReadonlyStore<RateSettings> };

/** Where one ticker shows the rate; supplied by the caller of `openTicker`. */
export type Screen = { readonly show: (rate: number) => void };
/**
 * One open ticker. `close` resolves when it no longer follows anything. It rejects if releasing was incomplete,
 * for example when a scope's close report has `complete: false` (a scope's `control.close()` itself never rejects).
 */
export type Ticker = { readonly close: () => Promise<void> };
export type QuotesPort = {
  /** Converts with the rate that is current at the moment of the call. */
  readonly convert: (eur: number) => number;
  /** Shows the current rate at once, then every change, until the ticker is closed. */
  readonly openTicker: (screen: Screen) => Ticker;
};

export type QuotesProduct = { readonly instance: undefined; readonly capabilities: { readonly "acme/quotes": QuotesPort } };
